pk.context: 1300 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability is approximately 45%, and it may be taken with or without food. It is only 3% bound to plasma proteins, and more than 95% is excreted unchanged in urine.
clues.substance: A synthetic crystalline powder, freely soluble in water, with a molecular weight of 157.2.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as 650 mg tablets, taken as 1300 mg three times daily.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated with combined hormonal contraception, active thromboembolic disease and hypersensitivity to it; headache and back pain are common.
clues.indication: Cyclic heavy menstrual bleeding in females of reproductive potential.
clues.mechanism: Occupies the lysine binding sites of plasmin and plasminogen, preventing plasmin from binding and dissolving fibrin, which preserves the fibrin matrix.

tell: A lysine-derived antifibrinolytic that is not recommended alongside all-trans retinoic acid, given its thrombotic risk.
